name: Fairy Tales
overview: Scripture distinguishes between godly teaching through parables, as Jesus used to reveal spiritual truths, and worldly fables that lead believers away from the truth. While Jesus spoke exclusively in parables to instruct the multitude, believers are warned to beware of philosophies and vain deceit rooted in human traditions rather than Christ. Additionally, Christians are cautioned against paying attention to fables and commandments of men that turn from the truth, emphasizing the need for discernment to remain faithful to biblical doctrine.
